description: This file contains test utility classes and delegate implementations for testing SpdyStream behavior in the net::test namespace, including classes for handling stream events, data reception, and stream closure.

classes.name: ClosingDelegate
classes.description: A delegate that calls Close() on the associated SpdyStream when OnClose is invoked, used for testing stream closure behavior.

classes.name: StreamDelegateBase
classes.description: Base class providing shared functionality for stream event handling, including waiting for stream closure and retrieving received data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDoNothing
classes.description: A delegate that performs no actions, used for capturing basic stream data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateConsumeData
classes.description: A delegate that consumes incoming data as it arrives.

classes.name: StreamDelegateSendImmediate
classes.description: A delegate that sends data immediately upon receiving headers.

classes.name: StreamDelegateWithBody
classes.description: A delegate that sends body data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateCloseOnHeaders
classes.description: A delegate that closes the stream when headers are received.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDetectEOF
classes.description: A delegate that detects EOF in data reception and sets a flag.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Handles early hints headers received on the stream.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Handles event when headers are sent.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming data on the stream.

methods.name: OnDataSent
methods.description: Handles event when data is sent.

methods.name: OnTrailers
methods.description: Handles trailers received on the stream.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure with a status code.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if frame type can be greased.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the NetLogSource associated with the stream.

methods.name: WaitForClose
methods.description: Waits for the stream to close and returns the close status.

methods.name: TakeReceivedData
methods.description: Drains and returns all received data from the stream.

methods.name: GetResponseHeaderValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific response header.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Returns load timing information for the stream.
